subject: Prorated seats + storage add-on after mid-cycle upgrade
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@aureliasys.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@aureliasys.com
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Charge for mid-cycle seat top-up + storage add-on (urgent)

Hi Aditya,

We just pushed a last-minute upgrade: added 8 seats and the 2TB storage add-on on Aug 18 (mid-billing cycle). Our billing portal shows an immediate charge attempt but the card failed (bank declined). Could you confirm how Redwood will prorate the additional seats and storage for the remainder of the month and reissue an invoice we can pay by bank transfer?

Specifics:
- Original seats: 12, upgraded to 20 on 2025-08-18 at ~15:30 UTC
- Storage add-on: +2TB (started same time)
- Company is Aurelia Systems (US) — we are VAT-exempt but need the invoice to show zero VAT and include our VAT exemption ID.

Can you: 1) Confirm pro-rata calculation and final amount owed for August; 2) Reissue invoice with VAT-exempt notation and bank transfer instructions; 3) Hold taxes/credits separate so our AP team can route payment quickly.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Liu
Head of Finance, Aurelia Systems

(Attachment: screenshot of failed card attempt: card-decline-0820.png)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@aureliasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, billing@aureliasys.com
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge for mid-cycle seat top-up + storage add-on (urgent)

Thanks for the note, Anna — and sorry about the payment trouble. Looping in Marissa from Finance to run the proration math and reissue an invoice with bank transfer details and VAT exemption noted. Sean, our account lead, is cc'd in case you want a short call to unblock AP.

Marissa — quick context: Aurelia upgraded from 12 -> 20 seats and added 2TB storage on 2025-08-18 15:30 UTC. They need: pro-rata amount for remainder of Aug, invoice showing VAT-exempt (include their exemption ID), and wire instructions. They tried card payment and it failed (screenshot attached).

I'll wait for the pro-forma from finance and will get this processed ASAP.

— Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

(Forwarded attachment: card-decline-0820.png)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@aureliasys.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, billing@aureliasys.com
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge for mid-cycle seat top-up + storage add-on (urgent)

Hi Anna / team — thanks for the details and the screenshot. I ran the numbers and attached a pro-forma invoice (proforma-prorate-0819.pdf) showing the pro-rated charges for the remainder of the billing cycle (Aug 19 - Sept 18 is how your billing period aligns after the upgrade). Summary below:

Summary (pro-rata):
- Seats: 8 additional seats, daily pro-rata for 31 days in cycle -> prorated days charged: 31 - 1 (since upgrade happened Aug 18 late) = 30 days; charge = (monthly per-seat rate $120) * 8 * (30/31) = $2,903.23
- Storage: 2TB add-on; monthly price $400; prorated charge = $400 * (30/31) = $387.10
- One-time invoice processing fee: $12.00
- Tax / VAT: marked as 0% and we included your VAT exemption ID on the invoice as requested.

Total due (bank transfer): $3,302.33 USD

Payment options included on the pro-forma: wire transfer (preferred for AP), ACH (US), and a retry of card payment. Bank details and reference string (DEAL-4821) are in the invoice. If you'd like us to accept a net-45 or PO, tell us and we'll route to Revenue Ops.

I've cc'd billing@aureliasys.com so your AP team sees the doc. Please confirm if the pro-forma looks good and we'll generate a DocuSign/official invoice and mark the account to attempt collection again if you prefer card.

Attachments: proforma-prorate-0819.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

(Internal note: I used the same proration rules as standard plan-level upgrades — we charge daily pro-rata based on the active billing period. Reached out to Revenue Ops for a quick audit of the calculation.)

From: billing@aureliasys.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Anna Liu <anna.liu@aureliasys.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 07:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge for mid-cycle seat top-up + storage add-on (urgent)

Hi Marissa / Aditya,

Thanks — invoice looks fine from our side but AP needs the bank account to be in beneficiary name "Redwood Inference, Inc" and the IBAN omitted (we are US-only wiring). Also can you include our PO # PO-9031 on the invoice? Finally, please confirm the VAT exemption ID printed is the one we provided (US-EXEMPT-4918).

Once you include the PO and beneficiary name we will initiate the wire today. If you prefer, we can also accept an immediate card retry if you can attempt it and share the retry link.

Regards,
Aurelia Billing Team

(Attachment: billing-instruction.pdf — internal workflow)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: billing@aureliasys.com, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge for mid-cycle seat top-up + storage add-on (urgent)

Thanks for the clarifications — I updated the invoice to: 1) Beneficiary = "Redwood Inference, Inc" 2) Removed IBAN and left routing/account for domestic wire 3) Added PO-9031 and your VAT exemption ID US-EXEMPT-4918 in the tax block. New invoice has been posted to DocuSign for signature and I attached the updated PDF for quick review.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/ua/?a=viewsign&doc=DS-4821

If you sign the DocuSign and confirm, we'll mark the invoice for wire collection and provide a receipt once funds clear. If AP needs net terms we can escalate to Revenue Ops but for now we'll proceed on wire.

Marissa

(Attachment: updated-proforma-0821.pdf)

From: Anna Liu <anna.liu@aureliasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@aureliasys.com
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge for mid-cycle seat top-up + storage add-on (urgent)

Marissa — signed the DocuSign and our bank initiated the wire this morning. Attached is the wire confirmation and we should see funds in 1–2 business days. Thanks for being responsive and for marking VAT-exempt.

I appreciate the clear breakdown — please send the final paid receipt once the funds are posted.

Anna

(Attachment: receipt-0822.pdf)
